name: Moz 0
summary:
Moz 0 is the first-generation robot in Spirit AI's hardware-development programme. The company's published history places its creation in July 2024, before the release of the Spirit v1 model and the later Moz1 robot.

Its role is as an early platform in the development of Spirit AI's embodied-intelligence systems. Detailed specifications and demonstrated functions remain sparsely documented in the cited history, so Moz1's force-control configuration and later task results should not be assigned to Moz 0.
